messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - HIGH error rate detected for /v1/generate (eu-west-1). Incident ID INC-2026-231. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-231. Runbook: /runbooks/api-error-spike

maya: I'm on shift until 02:00 UTC, taking primary for this one. I'll own the mitigation steps and triage.

ravi: I can be secondary and take comms unless you want someone from CS to own customer messaging.

aldo: Quick signal: alerts show 5xx spike starting ~1798531800, not all customers affected — mainly embeddings and batch endpoints. I pulled sample logs, lots of OOM-ish traces on pool-3.

maya: Thanks. Role proposal: primary = maya, comms = ravi, escalation = aldo. If anything needs legal/enterprise comms we escalate to sophie.

ravi: ack. I'll draft an initial customer-facing blurb and post to #support-ops. Will ping CS leads for impacted accounts.

aldo: Repro snippet from the node:
```
2026-10-12T18:36:22Z ERROR runtime: OOM while allocating KV cache size=2.1G model=redwood-7b
stack: alloc -> evict -> crash
```

maya: Following runbook step 2.2: rolling disable new prefix batching on pool-3 to prevent large KV growth. Command: 
```
# disable batching on pool-3
curl -s -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/api/pools/pool-3/config 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"features": {"prefix_batching": false}}'
```

ravi: Posted initial note in #support-ops: "We're seeing elevated errors in EU, teams investigating. Next update in 10m." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by maya (1798532125)

aldo: Running a quick KV cache flush on affected nodes as per runbook step 2.5. If that doesn't help we'll rollback the quantized model variant to v3.1.

maya: Starting KV flush now on node-7 and node-9. ETA ~3m. If error rate doesn't drop, we'll consider evicting pool-3 from routing (can be done via `robinsh` route disable).

sophie: FYI i'm on-call backup and will take over primary at 02:00 UTC if still open. Leaving my calendar slot pinned. If anyone needs escalation for enterprise customers, tag me.

maya: Noted. Handoff plan: if unresolved at 02:00 UTC, primary->sophie. Comms stays with ravi unless he hands it to CS. I'll leave a short handoff doc in the incident ticket with actions taken and current hypothesis.

ravi: I'll also maintain a running timeline in the ticket and post the next public update at +20m.

aldo: KV flush complete on node-7/node-9. Error rate dropped ~60% for embeddings route, CPU still spiky on pool-3.

maya: Good. I'll keep primary and follow up with a partial routing exclusion for pool-3 (rolling) to see full impact. If we do that, note for sop: include `--graceful=30s` to avoid in-flight token loss.

ravi: Customer note updated with current mitigation and ETA. Created CS case CS-345. Tagging product for visibility.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-231 status -> acknowledged · updated by maya · severity P1.

maya: Leaving a handoff comment in the ticket: "primary=maya until 02:00 UTC, comms=ravi, escalation=aldo, mitigation steps: disabled prefix batching, KV flush on node-7/9, preparing routing exclusion for pool-3. Hypothesis: KV growth -> OOM on quantized model variant. Next: routing exclusion, monitor 10m, then rollback variant if no improvement."

sophie: Thanks, I'll pick this up if it's still active at 02:00. If anyone wants to swap comms before then, ping me.

ravi: copying the handoff note to #ops-handoffs channel for oncoming shift.

maya: continuing to monitor; will post update in 10m or on significant change.

aldo: If we need to escalate to infra for node replacement, I have a contact; otherwise holding here.
